description: This file is the Hammer.js library (version 2.0.7), a JavaScript library for handling touch gestures and input events. It defines classes and functions for managing various input types (mouse, touch, pointer) and gesture recognition.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Base class for managing input events from various input types (mouse, touch, pointer).

classes.name: PointerEventInput
classes.description: Handles pointer events (including IE10 pointer events).

classes.name: TouchMouseInput
classes.description: Handles combined touch and mouse input, with de-duplication.

classes.name: TouchAction
classes.description: Manages touch-action CSS property or its polyfill.

methods.name: setTimeoutContext
methods.description: Sets a timeout with a specific scope.

methods.name: invokeArrayArg
methods.description: Executes a function on each element of an array argument.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over objects or arrays.

methods.name: deprecate
methods.description: Wraps a method with a deprecation warning and stack trace.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Extends objects by copying properties.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends an object with properties from another object, with optional merging.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges properties from source into destination without overwriting existing properties.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Sets up inheritance between constructor functions.

methods.name: bindFn
methods.description: Binds a function to a specific context.

methods.name: boolOrFn
methods.description: Returns a boolean or the result of a boolean function.

methods.name: ifUndefined
methods.description: Returns the second value if the first is undefined.

methods.name: addEventListeners
methods.description: Adds multiple event listeners to a target.

methods.name: removeEventListeners
methods.description: Removes multiple event listeners from a target.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if a node is in a parent node.

methods.name: inStr
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a substring.

methods.name: splitStr
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of words.

methods.name: inArray
methods.description: Checks if an array contains a value or finds its index.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts array-like objects to real arrays.

methods.name: uniqueArray
methods.description: Returns a unique array based on values or keys.

methods.name: prefixed
methods.description: Gets the vendor-prefixed property name if available.

methods.name: uniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID.

methods.name: getWindowForElement
methods.description: Returns the window object for a DOM element.

methods.name: createInputInstance
methods.description: Creates an input handler instance based on support.

methods.name: inputHandler
methods.description: Processes input events and recognizes gestures.

methods.name: computeInputData
methods.description: Computes gesture data like scale, rotation, velocity.

methods.name: computeDeltaXY
methods.description: Calculates delta X and Y for gestures.

methods.name: computeIntervalInputData
methods.description: Calculates velocity and direction over intervals.

methods.name: simpleCloneInputData
methods.description: Clones input data for gesture calculations.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates the center point of pointers.

methods.name: getVelocity
methods.description: Calculates velocity between points.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Determines gesture direction.

methods.name: getDistance
methods.description: Calculates distance between points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Calculates angle between points.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Calculates rotation between pointer sets.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Calculates scale factor between pointer sets.
